# Agent worth and coverage

Search explicit local definitions/registries, organization-approved assets,
reputable public implementations and broader web sources only when authorized.
Label coverage `exact`, `extendable`, `composable`, `adjacent`, `none` or
`unknown`; failed search is `unknown`.

A new agent needs a distinct mission plus a meaningful context, permission,
state, model, latency, ownership or verification boundary. Reject role titles,
novelty and raw frequency without reusable outcome evidence. Include model/tool
drift, documentation ownership, eval upkeep, incident response and retirement
in lifecycle cost.
